checkpoint_finding.rule: A future supervised state is target-label-unexposed only when normalization, features, PCA, graph settings, classifier, calibration, and thresholds are fit within development participants. A target-fitted unsupervised partition is transductive by design and must be evaluated under that separate task.

input_eligibility.gse192741: All three lanes are structurally applicable to Visium, but four donors and unresolved hg19 annotation permit only future technical fixtures.
input_eligibility.gse292268: Expression-only and simple spatial-neighbor lanes are structurally applicable after donor joins. BayesSpace spot-lattice assumptions are not portable to CosMx cells without a newly derived single-cell model and task.
input_eligibility.hra007511: All three transcript-native Visium lanes are plausible only after permission, participant and section joins, output rights, and runtime admission. H&E and MALDI are excluded.
input_eligibility.vu2025: All three Visium lanes are plausible only after the DSA and barcode-to-participant map clear. Arrays may not define donor graphs or BayesSpace lattices.

exposure_and_leakage_findings.strict_supervised_lane: HVGs, PCA, classifier, calibration, thresholds, lambda, and tunable graph settings are fitted on development participants, then each held participant is transformed without access to held labels or other held participants.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.transductive_partition_lane: PCA, graph features, K-means, Leiden, or BayesSpace fitted on a target cohort are cohort partitions rather than frozen participant predictions.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.graph: Every spatial graph and lattice must respect participant and section boundaries. Technical arrays, slides, and shared coordinate systems are not biological units.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.BayesSpace: Subspots generated by enhancement are model-derived, not observed, and cannot inflate replication or serve as high-resolution truth.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.assay: The suite is transcript-native. H&E, CODEX, and MALDI require separate feature and likelihood contracts and cannot be silently appended.

known_incidents_and_biases: Top-level package artifacts are pinned, but the complete Python, R, compiled-library, BLAS, Leiden, igraph, and BayesSpace transitive runtime is unresolved.
The registered python-igraph wheel is a small wrapper and does not identify the transitive native igraph core.
PCA, graph smoothing, clustering, and batch correction are transductive when fitted using held observations, even without labels.
Leiden resolution, K-means cluster count, BayesSpace q, and label mapping can overfit held annotations if not locked on development participants.
Spatial smoothing can blur boundaries and create apparent agreement; expression-only and unsmoothed controls must remain in the same evaluation.
Modeled subspots, cells, spots, graph nodes, sections, arrays, and posterior draws are not biological replicates.
remaining_blockers: Obtain a rights-cleared powered participant-linked spatial RNA dataset, registered endpoint, and genuinely external source.
Freeze the complete Python and R environments, including exact native igraph, compiled BayesSpace, BLAS, and transitive artifacts, and review assembled distribution obligations.

Register strict supervised and transductive partition tasks separately with participant-level endpoints, identical folds, fixed seeds, calibration where applicable, and prospectively selected hyperparameters.
Implement and hash participant-blocked expression and coordinate graphs; reject graphs spanning technical arrays, slides, sections, or donors without authoritative topology.

Pass CPU SLURM fixtures for normalization, HVGs, PCA, neighbor features, K-means, Leiden, BayesSpace chains, deterministic seeds, spot and row order, modeled-subspot exclusion, no-network rebuild, and output round trip after activation and campaign approval.
Retain these baselines through final selection if a spatial track activates; a simple baseline is allowed to be the released champion.
interpretation: This suite is the mandatory control for a future spatial benchmark, not an optional low-capacity screen. It has no upstream corpus contamination, but every fitted transform and partition still has donor, graph, target-distribution, and hyperparameter leakage risks. No eligible task, dataset, or seal exists now, so it remains deferred without execution.
